visual_goal: Reveal that heat is being moved from the cold compartment to the surroundings.

replace with a different refrigerator model
move to an unrelated kitchen without a context switch
alter component locations merely for visual convenience

technical_constraints: Heat-flow arrows must indicate heat moving from the cooled interior toward the exterior.
Do not alter refrigerator door/body geometry when creating the cutaway.
